method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: Phantom pain is assessed as a distinct real experience, with prescribed management reviewed. Relaxation-first delay is now a plausible incomplete response; phantom-pain source replaces generic transfers.

Established reliable eye-gaze communication preserves direct preference expression despite speech/hand limitations. A hand-marked form is inaccessible; ALS communication/professional relationship refs now match.

Earlier smaller meal and upright interval directly address the described reflux pattern. Food exclusion without size/timing change is a plausible incomplete trigger modification; GERD source appropriate.
Offloading bedding contact targets the stated gout pain stimulus. A thin but tucked sheet may retain contact; gout-specific support now replaces mobility reference.

Individual tolerated-food/utensil trials with intake monitoring address treatment-related metallic taste. Preset protein restriction or greater portions can worsen intake; BC Cancer taste guidance is topic-relevant.
Cool smooth nonacidic food is the best option for painful mucositis with safe swallowing. Comparators have concrete heat/acidity/roughness problems. BC Cancer mouth-pain reference now appropriate.

Trunk/utensil control and swallow/endurance directly determine safe assistance. Unit meal duration/staffing are resources, not patient capability. Nutrition and dysphagia refs now match the narrowed objective.
Contrast and lighting address the demonstrated visual barrier; bigger same-colour plate does not. Low-vision source is relevant without inferring brain injury in the client.
Planned pouch emptying and comfortable clothing support the outing; skipped food and unnecessary frequent changes can add burden. Ostomy reference replaces unrelated transfers.

Maintained balance/tolerable symptoms are direct performance evidence. Correct aid setup is a relevant necessary condition but not sufficient evidence of capacity; the equipment-brand filler is removed.
Suitable lever changes the painful small-joint twist demand; an equivalent round tap does not. Assistive-device source supports the adaptation context.

Reviewing skin care and prescribed removal schedule addresses removable-splint moisture while preserving treatment; independently shortening wear is not automatically warranted. Skin/position refs are topic-relevant.

Independently recomputed actual consumption:120+90+60=270mL. Alternatives now represent counting served quantities or subtracting the wrong component. Nutrition/intake source replaces transfers; no clinical dosing claim is made.
Independently checked200/100×150=300kcal. Alternatives represent label-portion, unit and consumed-volume errors; nutrition reference is appropriate to an intake calculation.

Agreed discreet request/support tackles reluctance while preserving control. Intermittent family reminders do not provide immediate reliable access; continence/professional relationship refs now match.
Reassessed pacing and a later nonurgent shower fit observed fatigue; no need to unilaterally reduce tomorrow’s rehabilitation. Source mapping now acknowledges activity/rest context.

Simplification and teach-back address reported usability during symptoms. Highlighting or handing the same complexity to an intermittently available relative may not resolve the barrier. Pain/relationship sources are related, not independent proof of every teaching detail.
